Guys, this format is weird. Turning other things into Impossible by editing footage into a chunk of Impossible? Not only is it unrelatable, but it also implies that you make Impossible out of humans, or whatever the subject in the video is. 

Seeing the firmness or texture of an Impossible sausage or burger after cooking or having quick recipe videos is much more impactful. Especially if the cooking videos target super easy recipes that don't require lots of skill.

Heck, letting me see how well an Impossible bratwurst holds up on a grill compared to other real bratwursts would significantly reduce my anxiety of being laughed at at the grill during a family barbecue if I was unfamiliar with the product.

Being able to also illustrate your catalog of different products is way way more valuable than this. Your chicken nuggets, tenders, meatballs, sausages, etc. should all be shown to demonstrate what they look like cooked. 

The best videos you can make is of strangers on the street trying your foods. Not this.
